name: Bellflower Chant
disable: DC 21 Performance check (trained) to join the chant, or DC 25 Society check to identify the Bellflower agents' tactics
routine: (1 action) The Bellflower chant continues their song. All non–Bellflower Network creatures in area A must attempt a DC 26 Will save save. On a failure, the target is offguard until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Find Freedom in the Song
items.text:
Trigger Zefiro becomes Grabbed or Restrained

---
Effect The Bellflower chant swells from the assembled crowd. All grabbed, restrained, or Immobilized creatures can attempt to Escape as a free action. The Bellflower chant then rolls initiative.

text: A chorus of Bellflower Network agents and allies chant about freedom from tyranny.
